Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and monitor oxygenation, given intubation, FiO2 70-80%, PEEP 8-10 cmH2O, and persistent hypoxemia.

Obtain repeat complete blood count to monitor severe thrombocytopenia and leukocytosis (WBC up to 21.6 K/uL).
Perform daily assessment of sedation and delirium with CAM-ICU and Richmond-RAS, given positive CAM-ICU and fluctuating sedation.
